name: Hotel Panorama
beschreibung: Hotel Panorama is set on a sunny hillside in Jerzens within Tyrol's scenic Pitztal Valley. The property offers comfortable, traditionally furnished rooms with private balconies showcasing sweeping mountain panoramas. In winter, guests enjoy effortless connectivity to the Hochzeiger ski resort and the Pitztal Glacier, while summer brings direct access to alpine hiking paths. Amenities include a restorative sauna wellness area, an outdoor terrace, and hearty regional dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Panorama in Jerzens in the Pitztal valley provides hillside lodging with panoramic alpine views, a sauna area, a sun terrace, and easy access to Hochzeiger.
